_comment: Provider/model/env-var names are configuration. API keys are read from the environment at call time and are NEVER stored here, in logs, or in artifacts.

judges._history: judge2 = Xiaomi MiMo mimo-v2.6-pro, the model actually used by the agent eval (amendment A1, commit 734ae6b; reports/agent_eval/judge_calls.jsonl). Same family as judge1 (weaker independence, reported), different model; still a different family/provider from the DeepSeek generator. Block-1 rejudge used OpenRouter google/gemini-3.8-flash (records in reports/judgments_block1_v2_records.jsonl); the OpenRouter key later had a $0 limit (HTTP 403), so it is no longer the configured judge2. Block-1 run2 OpenRouter gemma/nemotron records are kept in reports/historical/. The earlier relay judge2 endpoint is retired and removed.
judges._removed: backup judge gpt-5.6-luna removed 2026-10-27: its relay answered as a different model (gpt-5.6-terra), suspected hidden prompt injection; banned for any use. judge2 = one model only, never switched; failures are reported as coverage x/N.
